summary: Reproduced the independent review's counterexamples at exact candidate commit d6959386c233a1fcb0d27030bc9f576ddd7ca26e. The candidate contained only qualification scripts/reports, so omitted chat fields still eagerly resolved to protocol defaults and overrode server preferences. The correction carries the chat fields explicitly supplied by the client into GenerateReqInput and merges with precedence explicit client value > preferred server value > model generation config > protocol default, while preserving legacy native-request precedence. The candidate's deterministic model generator and live probe are retained as useful validation tooling.

gpu_execution_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950 as reported by the prepared ROCm PyTorch capability (9,5)) ran the tiny Llama server with torch_native attention and both graph phases disabled. The live probe completed all inference paths successfully. Server log retained at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ea87d695e8f2/artifacts/server-after.log. GPU execution is integration evidence; the decisive source regression is the CPU request path.
remaining_limitations: The live model uses deterministic random tiny-Llama weights, so it validates request precedence and engine execution, not semantic model quality.
Prefill and decode graph modes were disabled because torch_native attention was selected for portable ROCm execution.
A non-fatal Torch Dynamo metrics serialization error appeared during warmup; the server became ready and all requests completed.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
